analysis:
Reviewed base_text units for docs/architecture/inference.md lines 1-797. These units are unchanged base context. Per the file_changes map (complete), the base side changes only lines 1087-1088, and the head side changes lines 1087-1090, 1101-1159 and 2041-2060. None of these ranges fall inside the supplied units.

The visible patch is documentation-only. It changes the scheduler table: Gemma 4 gets a wider prefill chunk/step (2048/4096), there are new env overrides DARKBLOOM_CBV2_PREFILL_CHUNK and DARKBLOOM_CBV2_STEP_TOKENS, solo stripe is none for Gemma 4, and a 512 bidirectional media chunk ceiling is added. These relate to availability and memory pricing (TB-007, T-029). They have no visible effect on encryption, attestation, authorization, or cache scoping. Wider chunks may change prefill activation memory bounds. Whether the activation reserve and admission account for a 2048-token Gemma chunk is an implementation question outside the supplied source.

In the base context, Nemotron Super prefix reuse is partitioned by the authenticated cache scope and is off without one (lines 231-238, 521-524). Image prefix identity is bound to a hash of the evaluated features. This is consistent with the T-041 scoping mitigations. The head changes at 1101-1159 and 2041-2060 were not visible in this batch, so integration should check whether they alter cache-scope, cacheSalt or media handling relevant to T-041/T-050.

No regression was identified from the supplied evidence.
